title: Consolidated Holdings
blurb: You found a holding company on one pushcart and close its deals by hand. Buy newsstands, diners and mills on up to savings banks, each seller asking more than the last, then hire a sales desk, an acquisitions desk and a board to run the firm for you. Keep an eye on the wire for tips, and grow until the firm can buy the tallest building in town.

shots.beat: Two minutes in: the sales desk takes over the deals
The first savings bank, with the executive floor hired
The Consolidated Building goes up for sale
